edges.reason: transfer() forwards the call to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
transferFrom requires ensure(_from,_to,_value) before mutating balances.
ensure falls back to condition(_from,_value) for non-whitelisted senders.
ensure derives the pair address via pairFor(factory,WETH,address(this)).
msg.sender is used as the implicit source of transfer().
msg.sender is compared with _from and used as allowance spender in transferFrom.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender], so the caller controls the slot key.
delegate guards on msg.sender == owner.
init guards on msg.sender == owner.
batchSend guards on msg.sender == owner and burns the owner balance.
setTradeAddress guards on msg.sender == owner.
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender at deployment.
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] when the caller is not _from.
transferFrom performs unchecked balanceOf reads and writes for _from and _to.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] after each successful move.
ensure short-circuits to true when _from or _to equals owner.
ensure short-circuits to true when _from equals the constant UNI router.
ensure short-circuits to true when canSale[_from] is set.
ensure short-circuits to true when _from equals tradeAddress.
condition reads the global _saleNum cap.
condition compares _onSaleNum[_from] with _saleNum.
condition enforces the _minSale lower bound on _value.
condition enforces the _maxSale upper bound on _value.
delegate requires msg.sender to equal the owner state variable.
delegate hands arbitrary calldata to an arbitrary address via delegatecall.
init requires msg.sender to equal owner before reconfiguring sale limits.
init writes _minSale = token*(10**decimals) with unchecked multiplication.
init writes _maxSale = maxToken*(10**decimals) with unchecked multiplication.
init writes the _saleNum cap from calldata.
batchSend requires msg.sender to equal owner.
batchSend mutates balanceOf[msg.sender] and balanceOf[_to] without SafeMath.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length unchecked.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender to equal owner.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist slot.
constructor sets owner = msg.sender, transferring full privileges.
constructor mints the whole supply to balanceOf[msg.sender].
constructor grants unlimited allowance uint(-1) to the fixed Uniswap router address.
constructor sets totalSupply = _supply*(10**decimals) with unchecked multiplication.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] using raw unchecked subtraction.
transferFrom adjusts balances with raw unchecked subtraction and addition.
The interposed arbitrary delegatecall can reach low-level call semantics on the target address.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is the recipient parameter of transfer().
_value is the amount parameter of transfer().
_from drives the whitelist evaluation inside ensure().
_to is compared against owner inside ensure().
_value is forwarded to condition() by ensure().
_from determines allowance and balance keys in transferFrom.
_to determines the credited balance in transferFrom.
_value is the amount debited and credited in transferFrom.
_spender is the approval key in approve().
_value is the approval amount in approve().
_from indexes _onSaleNum in condition().
_value is range-checked in condition().
a is the delegatecall target in delegate().
b is the delegatecall calldata in delegate().
saleNum is stored into _saleNum by init().
token is stored into _minSale by init().
maxToken is stored into _maxSale by init().
_tos is the recipient array iterated by batchSend.
_value is the per-recipient amount in batchSend.
addr is stored into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress.
factory is hashed into the CREATE2 pair derivation.
tokenA participates in the ordered pair hash.
tokenB participates in the ordered pair hash.
_name is assigned to the name state variable.
_symbol is assigned to the symbol state variable.
_supply is scaled into totalSupply without SafeMath.
local total is the result of the unchecked multiplication.
loop local _to is the credited recipient in batchSend.
local _UNI is the pair address compared in the ensure() whitelist.
